reviews.review_text: This took alot of work to assemble even with two ppl, only because the instructions were unclear. Download the app that comes on a paper in the box, it will help. Would order again. Springs make noise when opening and closing. Maybe DW40 will help... plenty of storage. Solid/Sturdy!
If you want coffee table to look nice and be affordable this is it for you. The quality is pretty meh but as long as you don't body slam someone on it you should be good

reviews.title: Bottom Shelf Before Other Set of Legs
reviews.review_text: Some scratches out of the box. Need to get furniture/wood pens to match the color and draw over the scratches. The assembly was cool using Bilt, but I did NOT realize that the bottom shelf was meant to go on before the second set of legs. I was using a power drill to secure everything tightly, and was unable to undo the second set of legs to fit the bottom shelf. So I took the included screws out of the legs/shelf and drilled through the legs and secured the bottom rack from the outside in using wood construction screws... Honestly you shouldn't punish people for trying to go ahead and put both sets of legs on only to have the assembly require one set of legs off for you to put the shelf in. Stop trying to fit everything together like a jigsaw puzzle with dowels and interlocking screws and just use regular holes and screws.
Missing the dwarf screwdriver needed to complete assembly. Bought my own and finished the job.
